frozen: 2026-11-01, plan v5 'Final owner decisions' (fully synthetic network, no archive read) and Gate 2 G2.4-G2.6; change only as a new version
purpose: Illustrative network for canal_ops_sim_v1: the real main canal line with synthetic offtakes, gates and schematic branches generated by fixed rules over the Lower Hrazdan observed zone parcels. Not a hydraulic design, not the real WUA network.

inputs.not_used: SQL archive and every archive-derived layer (point and layer tables, DWG, blocks)

canal.orientation_note: Chainage runs downstream from 0 for each stage. Stage I flows west from the head; stage II continues west from the end of stage I, so its line is reversed. Checked against the terrain profile in summary.json.

assignment.max_distance_note: 3 km leaves about 70% of observed-zone parcels unassigned (the zone reaches 6-10 km south of the canal); 6 km is the smallest whole km that meets the 90% target. Sensitivity in summary.json.
assignment.rule: nearest stage line; offtake of the parcel's own (stage, community, chainage window) group, which is the nearest upstream offtake listing that community; otherwise unassigned, never forced

offtakes.rounding: floor, so the offtake is upstream of every parcel it serves
offtakes.min_group_rule: a (stage, community, window) group under min_group_ha joins the same community's nearest upstream group on its stage; with none upstream, the next group downstream joins it and the offtake moves to the joined group's upstream end. Keeps the nearest-upstream-offtake rule.

gates.order: per offtake and canal side: 250 m chainage bins from the offtake, distance from the canal ascending in even bins and descending in odd bins (serpentine), then parcel id; contiguous runs split by least squared deviation from target_ha with undersize gates penalised first

spurs.style: dashed schematic straight line from offtake to gate centroid, display only

labels.network: Illustrative network: real main canal, synthetic offtakes, gates and branches
